en: Shoots peas at one pest. Hits crows too.

Throws a tomato that hits the whole crowd.

en: Bees sting and keep stinging for a while. Hit crows.

en: Blocks the road and holds pests back. Repair it for coins.
Fast and weak — the goose will handle it.

en: Slow and tough — use the cannon or the hive.

en: Dives underground and passes under fences. Hit it when it pops up.

en: Flies straight to the bed. Only the goose, the hive and the hero hit it.

en: Boss: breaks a fence in 2 hits and stuns the hero. Bring everything!
Ads are not available, try later

en: Drag your finger or use WASD — the hero throws apples at pests by himself.
Pick up the coins pests drop.

en: Stand on a plot and pick a defender — your coins build it. Stand again to upgrade.

en: Keep the carrots safe: the fewer you lose — the more stars you get.
Trying on — for the next fight
Come every day — the gifts grow!
Come back tomorrow and get %d grains!

en: At the end of a level the Fox comes: strong, breaks fences and stuns the hero. Get your defenders ready!

You throw twice as hard and fast
